title: Nested Convex-Body Chasing for Online Optimization with Evolving Feasible Sets
abstract: arXiv:2608.29074v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study online optimization with nested shrinking feasible regions in two settings: convex optimization with nested evolving feasible sets (CONES) and adversarial constrained online convex optimization (COCO). Our algorithms separate loss control from geometric movement: constrained minimizers and cumulative-loss tests preserve regret guarantees, while a deterministic resettable nested convex-body chaser limits movement.   For CONES with a $G$-Lipschitz, $\mu$-strongly convex objective on a diameter-$D$ domain, we chase intersections of the current feasible set with adaptive objective sublevel sets. Using the Euclidean chasing ratio $O(\sqrt{d\log(1+d)})$, we obtain nonpositive regret at every prefix and movement $O(\sqrt{d\log(1+d)\,GD\log(eT)/\mu})$. The bound adapts to the increase in the constrained optimum value. In dimension two, with all other parameters fixed, every randomized algorithm with terminal expected regret $O(T^\beta)$

translated_title: 面向可行集演化的在线优化的嵌套凸体追踪方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了两类具有嵌套收缩可行区域的在线优化问题：具有嵌套演化可行集的凸优化（CONES）和对抗性约束在线凸优化（COCO）。我们的算法将损失控制与几何移动分离：约束极小化和累积损失测试用于保持遗憾保证，而一个确定性的可重置嵌套凸体追踪器用于限制移动。对于在直径为 D 的域上具有 G-Lipschitz、μ-强凸目标的 CONES 问题，我们追踪当前可行集与自适应目标次水平集的交集。利用欧几里得追踪比 O(√(d log(1+d)))，我们在每个前缀处获得非正遗憾，移动量为 O(√(d log(1+d) GD log(eT)/μ))。该界可自适应于约束最优值的增加。在二维情形下，当其他参数固定时，每个终端期望遗憾为 O(T^β) 的随机算法……
tldr: 该论文提出将损失控制与几何移动分离的算法框架，通过可重置的嵌套凸体追踪器，在可行集不断收缩的在线优化中同时实现每个前缀的非正遗憾和有界的移动量。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes algorithms that separate loss control from geometric movement via a deterministic resettable nested convex-body chaser, achieving nonpositive regret at every prefix and bounded movement for online optimization over nested shrinking feasible sets.
